title: Police evacuate 28 children from Sloviansk and Kramatorsk communities in one day
summary: In the Donetsk region, police evacuated 28 children from the Sloviansk and Kramatorsk communities over the past 24 hours. More than 1,400 children remain in settlements where mandatory evacuation has been declared.

title: Russia holds 385 Crimean political prisoners in detention – human rights activist
summary: Russia is holding 385 Crimean political prisoners in places of detention, 113 of whom belong to the indigenous Crimean Tatar people.

title: DIU's Prymary unit receives UAH 4.2M worth of combat drones from donors
summary: The Prymary special unit of the Defense Intelligence of Ukraine (DIU) has received combat drones worth UAH 4.2 million from charitable donors.

title: ZNPP loses external power supply, switches to diesel generators
summary: The Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant (ZNPP) has lost its external power supply and is operating on diesel generators.

title: Russia reports damage to bridge on highway connecting Rostov-on-Don with temporarily occupied Ukrainian territories
summary: A bridge over the Mius River in Russia's Rostov region has been damaged in a drone attack. The bridge is located on the Novorossiya highway, which leads to Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine.

title: War update: 199 combat engagements on front line over past day
summary: A total of 199 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defence Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line over the past 24 hours.

title: Russian forces kill five residents of Donetsk region over past day
summary: Five people were killed in Russian shelling in the Donetsk region over the past day. Three died in Kramatorsk, while two others were killed in Bilenke and Druzhkivka.

title: Drone damages residential buildings in Khmelnytskyi, leaving one injured
summary: Residential buildings in central Khmelnytskyi were damaged in an attack by an enemy drone. One person sustained injuries.

title: Russian forces attack industrial facility in Rivne region
summary: A Russian overnight attack caused a fire at an industrial facility in the Sarny district of the Rivne region, destroying one of its buildings.

title: Temperatures to reach +10°C in Ukraine on Sunday, no precipitation expected
summary: On Sunday, November 8, Ukraine will experience partly cloudy weather with no precipitation expected. Daytime temperatures will range from +1°C to +6°C, reaching up to +10°C in the Zakarpattia region.

title: Russia loses another 2,290 troops, four air defence systems in war in Ukraine over past day
summary: Russia's total estimated combat losses since the beginning of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, from February 24, 2022, to November 8, 2026, amount to approximately 1,606,400 personnel, including 2,290 over the past 24 hours.

title: ADF neutralises 137 of 164 Russian drones overnight
summary: Ukraine's air defence forces neutralised 137 of the 164 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine since the evening of November 7.

title: Defence Ministry specialists destroy more than 480,000 explosive devices since start of war
summary: Demining units of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and the State Special Transport Service, operating under the Ministry of Defence, have destroyed 483,702 explosive devices since the beginning of Russia's full-scale invasion.

title: SSU Alpha Special Forces destroy nearly 4,900 enemy UAVs, ground drones in one month
summary: In October, special forces of the Security Service of Ukraine's (SSU) Alpha unit destroyed 4,883 Russian UAVs and unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) of various types, as well as 11 Russian command posts.

title: Russian forces making attempts to advance towards Radkivka in Kupiansk sector – Trehubov
summary: Russian troops are making some attempts to advance towards the village of Radkivka in the Kupiansk sector.

title: Traffic across Dnipro Hydroelectric Power Plant dam in Zaporizhzhia to be temporarily suspended
summary: On Sunday, November 8, traffic across the Dnipro Hydroelectric Power Plant (DniproHES) dam in Zaporizhzhia will be temporarily suspended.

title: Russian attack on Odesa kills one
summary: One person was killed and infrastructure was damaged in an attack by Russian forces on Odesa.

title: Finland studies Ukraine's experience with anti-tank fortifications along border with Russia
summary: Finland is exploring the possibility of building anti-tank obstacles similar to those used in Ukraine to strengthen its defences along the border with Russia.

title: Power outage schedules to be in effect in some regions on Sunday, covering 1.5 to 4 groups
summary: Electricity consumption restrictions will be imposed in some regions of Ukraine on Sunday, November 8.

title: Kyiv's bus fleet cannot fully replace all electric public transport – City Military Administration
summary: Kyiv's bus fleet is currently unable to fully replace all electric public transport in the capital.

title: Anand expresses her position on abduction of children and Russian strikes on civilians to Lavrov
summary: Canada's foreign minister said she would not invite her Russian counterpart to any meeting, but used the opportunity at the G20 meeting to convey her position to him on the abduction of Ukrainian children, attacks on civilians and strikes on energy infrastructure.

title: Russia brings additional forces into Oleshky and surrounding community under cover of humanitarian operation – Zelensky
summary: Russian troops brought additional forces into the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky and the surrounding community under the cover of a humanitarian operation. The Ukrainian Armed Forces Command is to submit proposals for providing additional protection to Kherson.

title: Zelensky instructs government to introduce free public transport programme in Kyiv
summary: During a conference call, President Volodymyr Zelensky reviewed the progress of restoration work in the Dnipropetrovsk and Kharkiv regions. He also instructed the Prime Minister to present a programme providing free travel on the capital's surface public transport and ensuring an adequate reserve of buses for Kyiv.

title: Traffic partially restored on Kyiv’s North Bridge
summary: Traffic on Kyiv’s North Bridge is being partially restored on Sunday, November 8.

title: Barrot announces France's participation in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi
summary: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot has said that France will take part in the trilateral meeting between Ukraine, the United States and Russia expected to be held in Abu Dhabi, UAE, on November 10–11.

title: Russian forces strike industrial facility in Poltava region
summary: The Russian army attacked an industrial facility in Kremenchuk District, Poltava region, with a drone. According to preliminary information, no one was injured.

title: Airstrike on underground school in Komyshuvakha: 29 of 55 victims identified
summary: A total of 55 people are now known to have been killed in the strike on an underground school in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region. The identities of 29 victims have been established.

title: Russian attack in Khmelnytskyi region leaves two injured
summary: Enemy drones attacked a residential building in Khmelnytskyi regin, and two people were hospitalised.

title: More than 800 km² liberated in Oleksandrivka sector this year thanks to Airborne Assault Forces – Zelensky
summary: More than 800 square kilometres have been liberated in the Oleksandrivka sector this year thanks to the actions of the Airborne Assault Forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine.

title: Defence Forces strike four enemy drone command posts in over past day
summary: Over the past 24 hours, Ukraine's Defence Forces struck four enemy drone command posts in the temporarily occupied territories of Zaporizhzhia, Kherson and Donetsk regions, as well as on Russian territory.

title: Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps reports 20,000 Russian casualties in one year on Pokrovsk front
summary: Units of the Ukrainian 7th Air Assault Corps killed or wounded more than 20,000 Russian troops in the Pokrovsk sector of the front in 2026.

title: Over 7,000 troops complete training under updated programs in Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps
summary: More than 7,000 service members of the 7th Air Assault Corps of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have undergone training under updated programs over the past year.

title: Germany cannot supply Ukraine with more Patriot systems, Pistorius says
summary: Germany is currently unable to provide Ukraine with additional Patriot air defense systems, as doing so would weaken Germany’s own defenses.

title: Sandu warns of new Russian attempts to destabilize Moldova
summary: Moldovan President Maia Sandu has said Russia will soon make new attempts to destabilize the situation in Moldova and create an impression of instability in the country.

title: Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps identifies its most in-demand military specialties
summary: Units of the 7th Corps of the Ukrainian Air Assault Forces are most in need of personnel to fill combat positions, particularly riflemen, grenade launchers, machine gunners and designated marksmen.

title: Russian attack sets trucks and warehouses ablaze at transport company in Dnipro
summary: Russian forces have again struck Dnipro, setting trucks and warehouses ablaze at a transport company.

title: Russia suffers record weekly losses of over 16,000 troops in early November – Ukraine’s General Staff
summary: Russian forces lost 16,130 personnel in the first week of November, the highest weekly figure since the start of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

title: Zelensky: Russia launches 115 missiles, nearly 1,900 guided bombs, over 3,000 drones at Ukraine in a week
summary: Over the past week, Russia launched 115 missiles of various types, nearly 1,900 guided aerial bombs and more than 3,000 attack drones at Ukraine. If Ukraine cannot obtain anti-ballistic missiles from its partners, the EU needs to adopt a strong 22nd sanctions package.

title: Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps expands APACHI Unmanned Systems Battalion
summary: In 2026, the 7th Air Assault Corps of the Armed Forces of Ukraine significantly expanded the 237th Separate APACHI Unmanned Systems Battalion, which was established in late 2025.

title: Russian drone strike on Dnipro suburbs kills one person, injures another
summary: Russian forces have struck the suburbs of Dnipro with a drone, sparking a fire.

title: Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps carries out 8,000+ missions using ground robots in 2026
summary: Units of the 7th Corps of the AFU Air Assault Forces completed more than 8,000 successful missions using ground robotic systems (GRS) in 2026.

title: Russian forces strike critical infrastructure facility in Cherkasy, power and heating disruptions possible
summary: Russian forces have attacked a critical infrastructure facility in Cherkasy, potentially causing disruptions to electricity and heating supplies.

title: Russian drones attack Volyn region overnight, fire breaks out at agricultural enterprise
summary: A Russian drone attack on the Volyn region overnight sparked a fire at an agricultural enterprise in the Lutsk district. The fire has since been contained.
